description: This file implements a Linux kernel driver for B53 network switch chip register access via memory-mapped I/O. It contains functions for reading and writing different data sizes to hardware registers, probe and remove functions for platform device integration, and module information.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 * val)
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit value from the specified register address within the device.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit value from the specified register address, handling endianness.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from the specified register address, handling endianness.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 48-bit value from the device, combining multiple register reads.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_read64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit value from the device.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write8(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u8 value)
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit value to the specified register address.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write16(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u16 value)
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit value to the register, handling endianness.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write32(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u32 value)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to the register, handling endianness.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write48(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 48-bit value to the device registers.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_write64(struct b53_device * dev,u8 page,u8 reg,u64 value)
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit value to the device registers.

methods.name: int b53_mmap_probe(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Probe function initializing the device during platform device registration.

methods.name: void b53_mmap_remove(struct platform_device * pdev)
methods.description: Cleanup function invoked when the device is removed.
